summary: New nether biomes don t work properly in buffet worlds
description: The bug The new nether biomes (nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas) do not work in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce - Create New World - Select More World Options - Make a buffet world - Select Soul Sand Valley - Set terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode Freezes the game before it even loads terrain (Image Below) -Surface mode creates a purely ocean world (This happened the first time i tried to make one but works fine now for some reason) The following list is updated in version 20w15a: Biomes All world generators that freeze the game Nether wastes Surface Crimson forest Surface Warped forest Surface and floating islands Soul sand valley Surface Basalt deltas Surface
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world.
3. Select "More World Options".
4. Choose "Buffet World".
5. Select "Soul Sand Valley".
6. Set the terrain type to "Floating Islands" or "Surface".
7. Wait for the game to load the terrain.
8. Observe that the game freezes before loading the terrain.
Observed Behavior: The new Nether biomes, including Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas, exhibit malfunctioning behavior when used in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. Specifically, when players create a new world, select the buffet world option, and choose the Soul Sand Valley biome while setting the terrain type to either Floating Islands or Surface, the game freezes before the terrain can even load. In some instances, the Surface mode generates a purely ocean world, although this issue seems to have resolved itself in later attempts. In the version 20w15a, it was confirmed that the game freezes with all Nether biomes set to Surface, including Nether Wastes, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, Soul Sand Valley, and Basalt Deltas. This behavior disrupts gameplay significantly, as players are unable to access the intended biomes in these world types, leading to a frustrating experience. The freezing issue appears to be tied to the generation of these biomes, which may not be compatible with the selected buffet world settings.
Expected Behavior: When creating a Buffet world and selecting a Nether biome such as the Soul Sand Valley, the game should successfully generate the chosen biome without freezing or crashing. The expected behavior is that players can explore and interact with the selected Nether biomes, including Nether Wastes, Crimson Forests, Warped Forests, and Basalt Deltas, in both Surface and Floating Island modes. Each biome should generate correctly, allowing players to experience its unique features and resources without any game stability issues.
